findings.reason: a node implementing §2 literally writes `sections`, contradicting the "unchanged" covered-case claim and the `impl_source` vocabulary the plan-review reader consumes, and it lacks the write scope to add the value to the schema.
findings.text: §2's done-when asserts the covered case parses with "source `sections`", but the deliverable says that case "stays … as it is today" and the code that produces it emits `impl_source = "computed"` (`reckon/_plan_html.py:1128`), while the schema enumerates only `["computed", "authored"]` (`reckon/_schema.py:112`) and the reader documents exactly those two (`reckon/crew/plan_review.py:122`); the new `declarations` value is likewise absent from that enum and `reckon/_schema.py` is not among §2's write paths

findings.reason: §6's done-when measures a fall in the non-shipped count attributable to honest readings, so with the precondition unenforced §6 can open its gate and run against the same dishonest impl/staleness figures it exists to correct.
findings.text: §6 states "Once §2 and §3 have landed, so the readings it starts from are honest", but no section-level `depends-on` links §6 to §2/§3 and its gate `g-tprt-portfolio-mode` requires only `the-codebase-is-reviewed-between-nodes#s8` (the command's existence), not §2/§3 landing

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/_plan_html.py:800-841` (`derive_impl_from_sections`, returns `None` on uncovered declarations), `reckon/doccheck.py:531` (getmtime) and `:154` (`ACTIVE_PLAN_STALE_AFTER_DAYS = 30`), `reckon/doccheck.py:874-901` (`unwired_plan_finding`), `reckon/project_state.py` (Sprint reader), `one-fact-has-one-reader.html`, `the-codebase-is-reviewed-between-nodes.html#s8`, and `docs/state/reckon/review.html` all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each of §2–§6 names an executed negative control and a measurable assertion, and each names a control whose failure is a named wrong reading (coverage fallback returning the authored figure, mtime-read age, plan-side-only comparison, gate-evidence clause removed, the 2026-10-10 63-plan baseline).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — tests sit under `tests/`, the round record under `docs/state/reckon/review.html` (present in the tree), and no gate writes to a scratchpad or node-local temp path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the done-whens name test files by mechanism (`test_impl_derives_from_declarations.py`, `test_staleness_counts_from_the_last_commit.py`, …); no plan label, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol, and no changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §2's mechanism sets impl_source for the covered case to today's value, but its done-when asserts a different source string; and §6's stated precondition is unenforced (below).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §2–§5 each carry one deliverable; §6 is one proving-run deliverable (its several dispositions are one round).
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §6 declares it runs "Once §2 and §3 have landed", but head carries no `plan-section-depends-on` and the plan's only gate (`g-tprt-portfolio-mode`) names `the-codebase-is-reviewed-between-nodes#s8` as its required evidence, so nothing encodes the §2/§3 precondition §6 states.
